description: Record money moving in a goal — **several in one call**. Six modes: DEPOSIT, WITHDRAWAL, TRANSFER between holdings, OPENING for what was already there when tracking started, and GAIN / LOSS for what the market did. **The mode carries the direction; the amount is always positive.** OPENING, GAIN and LOSS are in the balance but are not money the user set aside, so they are kept out of the savings rate. **Dry-runs by default**; the document is copied to a timestamped .bak first. Editing and deleting a movement are app-only. A DEPOSIT here is money **set aside** by hand, still inside the bank; deposits **read from the bank** come from the Money moved category a goal reads (`set_goal_deposit_categories`).

commit.description: Default false. False previews the batch; true writes it.

deposits.description: One entry per movement. Up to 60 in a call.

amount.description: Always positive, in major units. The mode decides the sign.

goal.description: The goal, by id or by name. It must already exist.

holding.description: What the money is held in. `{ "id": … }` for a holding `savings` listed, or `{ "name": …, "kind": …, "is_liquid": …, "provenance": …, "place": … }` to create one. **Money always lands in a holding**, never in a bare place: the cash and the fixed deposit at one bank are two holdings, and only one of them is reachable this week.

is_liquid.description: Whether the money is reachable this week. **The user’s answer, not the kind’s** — a fixed deposit with six months to run is not liquid. Needed only when creating.

kind.description: One of CASH, DEPOSIT, FUND, TRACK, SECURITY, OTHER. Needed only when creating.

name.description: The holding by name. A name matching nothing creates it.

place.description: Where the money is — the bank or broker. `{ "id": … }` for a place `savings` listed, or `{ "name": …, "kind": … }` to create one. Needed only when creating the holding.

kind.description: One of CHECKING, DEPOSIT, INVESTMENT, CASH, OTHER. Needed only when creating.

name.description: The place by name. A name matching nothing creates it.

provenance.description: One of RECORDED, TRANSCRIBED, VALUED: how the balance is known. RECORDED is the running total of what was entered and nothing will ever confirm it; TRANSCRIBED means a statement prints the figure; VALUED means holdings times a price. **Declared, never inferred** — a deposit with no statement transcribed yet is still TRANSCRIBED. Needed only when creating.

mode.description: One of DEPOSIT, WITHDRAWAL, TRANSFER, OPENING, GAIN, LOSS. Default DEPOSIT. WITHDRAWAL and LOSS store a negative amount; TRANSFER writes two legs that cancel out.

note.description: Required for WITHDRAWAL — a balance that dropped for no recorded reason is what makes people stop trusting the number. A LOSS needs none: the mode is the why.

to_holding.description: What the money is held in. `{ "id": … }` for a holding `savings` listed, or `{ "name": …, "kind": …, "is_liquid": …, "provenance": …, "place": … }` to create one. **Money always lands in a holding**, never in a bare place: the cash and the fixed deposit at one bank are two holdings, and only one of them is reachable this week.
